texts.zh: 依照参议院大多数的表决，泛星系防卫军被解散了。所有现役的泛星系防卫军人员将返回其母国，而防卫军的战舰将在参议院官员的密切监督下拆解，以防止这些战舰落入心有不轨之人的手中。
texts.en: By order of the Senate majority, the Galactic Defense Force has been disbanded. All serving GDF personnel have returned to their home nations, and their warships are being scuttled under the close supervision of Senate officials to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.
